response.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY operation

assumptions.assumption: Large means amount strictly greater than 2400. The request calls 2400 a cutoff but doesn't say whether 2400 itself counts.
Transactions with no operation are rows where operation IS NULL. GROUP BY puts them in one group, shown with a NULL operation.
Types other than PRIJEM and VYDAJ (e.g. VYBER) give a NULL in the CASE, so AVG skips them. They still count in the total.

alternatives.interpretation: Large means amount at or above 2400 (>=).
alternatives.sql: SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY operation
